question: Jaya, from point A, walks 349 m towards the south. She takes a left turn and walks 129 m. She takes a left turn again and walks 349 m. She then takes a right turn and walks 94 m to reach point B. How far and in which direction is point A from point B? (All turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution:
From the given information:

Step 1: Jaya, from point A, walks 349 m towards the south. She takes a left turn and walks 129 m.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db579035d524e501e4c006eb75b7a8a4cc317ff90d45f257c3d7628227dc70c3.png] 

Step 2: She takes a left turn again and walks 349 m. She then takes a right turn and walks 94 m to reach point B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e0efb1f095080832993a395207a5385eb6987d7af17038f9d894ef52049f9e05.png] 

Distance from A to B = 129m + 94m = 223m

From the diagram, we can see that **point A is 223m towards the west from point B.**

Hence the correct answer is **option 3)**
